name: ashokmalhi-academic-website
description: Official academic identity platform for Dr. Ashok Malhi (Assistant Professor, Lovely Professional University). MERN + TypeScript monorepo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server --if-present && npm run test --workspace=client --if-present
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Root install complete. Run npm run dev to start both client and server.'

author: Dr. Ashok Malhi
